title: sin(1) <= 1/1! = 1, the exact real upper bound on sin(1)
statement: CReal.sinOne_alternating_upper (this batch) at m := 0, mirroring CReal.cosOne_le_exp_term_zero exactly except that sinTerm(0) reduces (by iota alone: pow(-1,0)=1, and 0+0+1=1) to mul(one, expTerm(1)) -- odd index 1, not 0. Folding add(zero, mul(one, expTerm(1))) down to expTerm(1) needs two genuine Equiv steps (add_comm+add_zero, one_mul), composed and transported across the inequality via CReal.le_congr. THIS SUPERSEDES any loose [-4,4]-style bound on sin(1) recorded elsewhere in the ledger without deleting it: this is the exact real interval [0, expTerm(1)] (paired with F:creal-sinone-nonneg), not a coarse envelope.
